shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' lib/db.js && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts && sed -n '1,200p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.next/*' -print && git status --short && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts && rg \"cacheTag\" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p' && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/cache.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && git diff -- app/page.tsx next.config.ts && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:package.json && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git show HEAD:next.config.ts && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' .gitignore && git diff --check && git diff -- tsconfig.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc 'find /workspace/.next -type f -delete && find /workspace/.next -depth -type d -empty -delete && unlink /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && unlink /workspace/next-env.d.ts && git status --short'
